name: Animated Inks
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, varies (Requires Attunement)*

---

When you drink this potion, a type of creature you are thinking of appears as a tattoo on your skin. You choose the type of creature but its maximum Challenge Rating|XPHB is determined by the potion's rarity, as shown in the table below.

You can take the Magic action to cause the tattoo to animate and move off your body, appearing in an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet. For the next 10 minutes, it uses the stat block of the chosen creature. During this time, the creature is Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative|XPHB count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other action. At the end of the 10 minutes, or when the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB, it returns to your body as a tattoo. Once you have used a Magic action to animate this tattoo, it can't be used again until 3 days pass.

If you end or lose Attunement|XPHB to this magic item, the tattoo disappears and all other effects of this potion end.

| Rarity | Maximum Challenge Rating |
| --- | --- |
| Animated Inks (Uncommon) | 1 |
| Animated Inks (Rare) | 3 |
| Animated Inks (Very Rare) | 7 |

name: Bonebreakers
descriptionMarkdown:
*Simple Weapon, legendary (by a pugilist)*

**Damage:** 1d4 bludgeoning | **Properties:** Light

---

These unremarkable brass knuckles appear well used if not well loved. They are covered in dings and scratches accompanied by the odd stain.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can attempt to maim them. When you do so, the creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be maimed in one of the following ways of your choice. The creature remains maimed until it is targeted by a Greater Restoration spell or similar magic. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

**Broken Arm.** The creature has Disadvantage|XPHB on attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes.

**Broken Leg.** The creature's Speed|XPHB is halved.

**Broken Ribs.** The creature has Disadvantage|XPHB on Strength and Dexterity ability checks and saving throws.

**Broken Skull.** The creature has Disadvantage|XPHB on Intelligence and Wisdom ability checks and saving throws.

descriptionMarkdown:
*Simple Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 1d4 slashing | **Properties:** Finesse, Light

---

Legend has it these hand claws were crafted from the talons of a fabled feline. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

**Darkvision.** While you are holding this magic weapon, you have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

**Feline Form.** While you are holding this magic weapon, you can cast Polymorph from it. When you do, the spell targets only yourself and the only form you can take is a Cat.

**Nine Lives.** The weapon has 9 charges. While holding it, when you fail a Death Saving Throw|XPHB you can expend 1 charge (no action required) to succeed on it instead. The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.
